plan.root_cause: The keyboard navigation for left/right arrow keys moves the date by one day without skipping disabled days (weekends). The test expects that from Friday 20 Nov, pressing ArrowRight selects Monday 23 Nov (skipping Saturday and Sunday).
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the `_onKeyChange` handler in the Pikaday constructor to implement custom day-stepping logic for left/right arrows that skips over disabled days (weekends) by repeatedly adding/subtracting one day until a non-disabled day is found, using the same disabled-day logic as the picker (minDate, maxDate, disableWeekends, disableDayFn).
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can navigate the date picker without landing on disabled weekend days, improving operability for users who rely on keyboard navigation (WCAG 2.1.1, 2.4.3).
functional_risks: The change only affects left/right arrow keys when the picker is visible. Week navigation (up/down) remains unchanged.
The loop has a safety limit of 365 iterations to prevent infinite loops.
verification_requirements: The existing journey test (ArrowRight from Friday 20 Nov results in Monday 23 Nov) should pass.
ArrowLeft from Monday 23 Nov should go to Friday 20 Nov (skipping weekend).
Week navigation (ArrowUp/ArrowDown) should still add/subtract 7 days.

plan.root_cause: The color contrast for the selected day button (data-pika-day="23") fails WCAG 1.4.3 because the selected state uses white text (#fff) on a blue background (#33aaff) with a contrast ratio of only ~2.9:1. The default button state (#666 on #f5f5f5) also fails at ~2.25:1. The automated rule flagged the selected button for day 23.
plan.repair_strategy: Darken the background colors for selected, range, and default button states to achieve at least 4.5:1 contrast with white text, and darken the default button text color for non-overridden states.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Selected day buttons, range buttons, and default day buttons now meet WCAG 1.4.3 contrast requirements (>=4.5:1) for text against background, improving readability for users with low vision.
functional_risks: Color changes are visual only; no functional behavior is altered.
The new dark blue (#002244) and dark green (#003300) may appear different from the original theme but maintain the same semantic meaning.
verification_requirements: Automated color-contrast rule should no longer flag button[data-pika-day="23"] in selected state.
Default day buttons (non-selected, non-today, non-disabled) should pass contrast with #222 on #f5f5f5.
Start-range and end-range buttons should pass contrast with white text on their new backgrounds.
